dslRule:
<!id: modernize.launch.executor>
<!description: Replace direct static call to StandaloneLaunchConfigExecutor.launchProcess with LaunchConfigurationViewPlugin.getExecutor().launchProcess for API migration.>
org.eclipse.debug.ui.launchview.internal.launcher.StandaloneLaunchConfigExecutor.launchProcess($config$, $mode$, $build$, $wait$, $logFile$)
=>
org.eclipse.debug.ui.launchview.LaunchConfigurationViewPlugin.getExecutor().launchProcess($config$, $mode$, $build$, $wait$, $logFile$)
;;
